description: Run a compiled <name>.flow.ts once under plain Playwright (no model) and report pass/fail (exit 4 = failed, 2 = could not run). With ready=true it runs the readiness gate (several clean runs) as a background job: the call returns a job_id; poll job_status.

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

fixture_isolation.description: Declare that project fixtures prepare fresh data (--fixture-isolation), with ready.

flow_file.description: Path to the .flow.ts file, relative to cwd or absolute.

ready.description: Readiness check (--ready), run as a job.

vars.description: Flow variables, passed as repeated --var k=v. "{n}" in a value is replaced per run with a fresh value. Never a secret: use {{env:NAME}} markers in instructions instead.

name: check
